Name: Flowing Mine Rocks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod changes the look of destructible rocks in the mine when they are connected together horizontally or vertically.

It contains 5 different colour rocks depending on the majority colour of the rocks joined.

Nodes with ores and gems have them displayed as embedded in the rock.

Node durability, drops, etc. are not affected in any way.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
